Requests name a level with --prism-tier ID; an old request that names only its steps maps 8 -> high, 20 or 30 -> max, 50 -> original (legacy_steps).

tiers.note: 260412 distill, 8 steps, CFG 2 on step 1; audio from the student's own v2a K/V (FP8 cache of the conditional pass, 30 fused layers), 4 audio sub-steps with CFG 5; no base pass, no extra download

260412 distill, 8 steps, CFG 2 on step 1; partial audio teacher: fused layers 0-9 keep the student's v2a K/V, the base pass runs layers 10-29 from the student's hidden states; 4 audio sub-steps, CFG 5 (~11% faster than High)
260412 distill, 8 steps, CFG 2 on step 1; full audio teacher (base pass over the 30 fused layers, 4 audio sub-steps, CFG 5) every step

Undistilled 20 steps, CFG 5 every step (joint video + audio), shifts 7/7, BSA 0.75/0.2; no step cache: the first-block cache (0.12 / 3) was 1.5x faster but lost most of the speech on case 6 (CER 0.57 against 0.14 without it)

Official recipe: base weights, 50 steps, CFG 5 every step (video + audio), shifts 7/7, BSA 0.75/0.2 IVPQ. Default bf16 weights (optional download) + exact bf16 attention; without the bf16 bundle it runs the installed int8/fp8 weights with Sage attention.

fields: steps, cfg_steps (int or "all"), cfg_scale, audio_cfg (null = joint CFG from the uncond pass), shift, audio_shift, distilled, audio_teacher {substeps, cfg, max_sigma, skip_below, every, sparsity, start_layer (partial teacher), calibrated ("identity": the student's own K/V instead of the base pass; true: through a prism-kv-calib/1 maps file)}, sparsity, cdf, weights (int8|fp8|bf16), attention (sage|exact), t2v (no first frame; distilled=false only), fallback (settings applied when the level's weights are not installed), fbcache / fbcache_max_skip (first-block step cache threshold and reuses in a row; absent = off)
